verdict.rationale: telli is an AI voice-agent platform, so noise suppression and audio filtering are a fair axis for it. The evidence pack documents no such capability. The only 'filter' mention (telli-docs-3) is about filtering the conversation list, not call audio, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can enable noise suppression or audio filtering so the agent stays coherent on noisy real-world calls
